Hi Carlos / team — thanks for the clear notes and for attaching your requirements. I pulled together the commercial paths and what each would require from Aurelia. Summary below and I attached a short one-page commercial-path summary and our marketplace options doc.

Option A — POC on corporate card (fastest)
- Timeline: hours to 2 days.
- Requirements: billing card, basic SSO setup optional.
- Good for: validating integration and user workflows.

Option B — PO / Invoice (Net30) to Redwood for production
- Timeline: 2–3 weeks (contract + PO + vendor setup).
- Requirements: signed MSA/Order Form; Redwood invoices per milestone/monthly; our Finance team accepts Aurelia PO.
- Notes: For HIPAA workloads, include BAAs and encryption/HSM details in SOW.

Option C — Cloud Marketplace (AWS Marketplace preferred)
- Timeline: 2–6 weeks depending on Aurelia's internal marketplace procurement pipeline and whether Aurelia requires Marketplace Consolidated Billing or a standard SaaS listing.
- Pros: single billing/chargeback to your AWS account, easier procurement centrally.
- Cons: Marketplace contract terms can add a small delay and may constrain pricing flexibility; depending on AWS flow, Redwood may appear as marketplace vendor or as reseller (we'll clarify).

Private / Dedicated Deployment
- We can support private deployment (VPC/VPN) and on-prem packages for PHI. That typically requires an engineering kickoff and an SOW; timeline 4–8 weeks after contract.

Suggested next steps:
1) Procurement ops and Aurelia finance confirm preferred billing path (Card for POC vs PO vs Marketplace).
2) If PO: share Aurelia vendor setup form and PO template; Rishi will route to Redwood Finance and Legal to prepare redlines.
3) If Marketplace: please share the internal AWS Marketplace contact or the ticket reference so we can align on listing mechanics.
4) Schedule 30-min procurement sync — I propose Wed 2 Jun at 10am PT or Thu 3 Jun at 11am PT.

Attachments: redwood-commercial-path-summary.pdf, redwood-marketplace-options.md

Happy to join the procurement call with Rishi and Marissa.
